payload.title: Verify and document the versioned scorecard app end to end
payload.description: Acceptance milestone covering migration, GraphQL contracts, restart/idempotency, interactive and replay cycles, joint requests, immutable labels/explanations, version comparison/revert, reachable classifier Save buttons, drawers and full-viewport tablet UX. All automated tests fake clients/no keys; browser test real deployed local app in desktop and iPad-sized viewports with no fabricated human votes. Verify timeline requests/responses and calibration snapshots through API/storage/UI, and Play/seek/zoom/pan. Preserve existing Anthus v1/v2 data; document what is implemented versus remaining. Publish concise usage/model/versioning/metrics/calibration semantics and operator recovery instructions. No promise calibration or accuracy always improves; compare on matched eligible evidence. User live labeling remains resumable and no paid run begins merely to view UI.
